hypothesis: Current-policy cycle mining, separate exit/relation budgets and constraints on actual Adam displacements can improve intermediate relations while reducing cycles and retaining correct restoration decisions.
architecture: Unchanged goal-independent 192->256->256->128 shared MLP, six solved-preserving aligned symmetry presentations, fixed Linf distance. Initialize all conditions from the retained symmetric_initial checkpoint. No new coordinate targets, heads, search or no-repeat inference rule.
comparison: Same initialization, closed protected mask, base batches, fresh Adam and attempted update budget. Base omits repair labels; repair and repair_guard share exit/relation weights and RNG seeds but their refreshed policy-dependent pools may diverge. Guard cost and accepted/rejected/scaled updates are reported; this is an intervention bundle, not an isolated estimate of mining versus reweighting.
guard_semantics: Select training-only complete stars with positive true-good-vs-bad distance margin >=0.02. Fixed cohort: 75% smallest positive margins and 25% depth-balanced correct stars. Add a refreshed dynamic cohort excluding fixed stars. Floor=min(0.5*margin_at_selection,0.25). Test all guard decisions against the actual proposed Adam parameter update; halve displacement until every floor holds within 1e-6. Accepted damped steps retain the ordinary current-gradient Adam moments; rejected steps restore parameters and all optimizer state. The guard is not a loss and uses no protected monitor labels. A finite training cohort does not certify global retention.
split: Reuse fixed-goal mask and historical cycle monitors. Select additional monitors from current symmetric-policy cycles before training; protect both endpoints and full stars, then close under six axis symmetries. All base, path, arbitrary and repair labels exclude protected states. Fixed random relation monitors reuse the historical cohort; arbitrary-goal monitors have protected goals. Pretraining may have seen these labels: continuation retention/transfer only.
selection: Fixed 200 attempted updates per condition, current-policy refresh every 50. Final checkpoint only. Success requires relation MAE reduction, fewer full-state two-cycles, nondecreasing full-state arrival and no fixed-guard ordering flips. Report each criterion separately. No automatic extension, no test-selected checkpoint, detailed failures remain in ignored runtime outputs.
